items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: he got Harold Baker who later was with Duke, playing first trumpet... I didn't get to hear the band in person, I heard them on record.

ctx.x: Oh, baby. Talk about clean. It was too clean to be a black band. That's the reason it didn't last. Because he had all of the best musicians, he sent out of state and got musicians, you know, he got Harold Baker who later was with Duke, playing first trumpet. He had a famous trombone player out of Detroit, forget his name. He had J. C. Heard on drums, Al Hall on bass. What else, that's about all I can name off hand because I didn't get to hear the band in person,
